dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What was all that running around for?

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: What do you mean, horsing around? I'm clearly training!

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: The grown-ups all say that I'm super fast! They say I'm the speediest brat that they've ever seen.

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: So I've got to work hard and play to my strengths, so I can eventually become the fastest warrior in the war against the Abyss!
